description: Additional workspace path analysis cases for extensionless paths, multi-dot names, hidden Unicode directories, and decomposed segments.

cases.description: An extensionless nested note reports a null extension without being hidden.
cases.expected_output:
path=notes/archive
name=archive
extension=null
hidden=false
is_nfc=true
is_nfd=true
has_non_ascii=false
char_length=13
byte_length=13

cases.description: A nested hidden Unicode directory with a multi-dot filename reports hidden status and final extension.
cases.expected_output:
path=notes/.секрет/файл.tar.gz
name=файл.tar.gz
extension=gz
hidden=true
is_nfc=true
is_nfd=false
has_non_ascii=true
char_length=25
byte_length=35

cases.description: A decomposed Unicode directory segment is NFC-normalized before path metadata is reported.
cases.expected_output:
path=café/notes.md
name=notes.md
extension=md
hidden=false
is_nfc=true
is_nfd=false
has_non_ascii=true
char_length=13
byte_length=14
